question: Where was the first Headquarters of the Theosophical Society established in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adayar **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Theosophy Society was** founded by Helena Petrovna** **Blavatsky** and others **in 1875.**
 
• The **designation 'Adyar'** is sometimes added to the name to make it clear that this is the **Theosophical Society** headquartered there, after the American section and some other **lodges separated from it in 1895**, under **William Quan Judge.**
 
• In 1882, its headquarters moved with Blavatsky and president Henry **Steel Olcott** from **New York to Adyar**, an area of **Chennai (Madras).**
 
• **The society's philosophy is based on three principles:** 
 
 
• Universal **brotherhood **
 
• **The study of comparative religion and philosophy **
 
• **Investigations into the nat**ural laws ​
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** **The Theosophical Society**

 
• The Theosophical Society, **founded in 1875**, is a **worldwide body** with the aim to advance the ideas of **Theosophy** in continuation of previous **Theosophists, especially the Greek** and Alexandrian Neo-Platonic philosophers dating back to the 3rd century CE.
 
• The** Bengal Theosophical Society **and the** Bombay Theosophical Society **were established in India.
